r.경제 체제: Market economy · farm goods, parts, remittances
r.빅맥지수: $4.56 for a Big Mac, $1.66 less than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)
r.생활 물가 수준: 50% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Soybeans and oilseeds 16%, Wire, cable 15%, Fruit, nuts 8%, Wheat 7%, Beverages 7% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Coated steel sheet 38%, Cars 31%, Cosmetics 10%, Precision and medical instruments 10% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Clothing (woven) 65%, Sweaters 14%, Other clothing (knit) 9%, Bags and leather goods 7% (2025, share of value)

t.why: Russian troops remain in Transnistria in the east. It is an EU candidate.
t.rel: It lies between Ukraine and Romania. Sharing language and history with Romania, it gets strong help with its EU bid. It faces Russia over troops in Transnistria and gas supplies, and became an EU candidate in 2022.
t.know: One of its underground wine cellars has tunnels running some 200 km.
t.etext: It sells wine, sunflower seeds and parts such as wiring, and remittances from workers abroad are large. Incomes are on the low side for Europe, and it is pursuing EU membership.
